**🚨 BREAKING: United Nation Space Command Forms Alliance With Atlas Forces**
@🚨 Breaking Pings 

**The United Nation Space Command (UNSC)** and **Atlas Forces (ATLF)** have officially announced a new alliance, establishing mutual defense and trade cooperation between the two factions.

On November 23, 2026, UNSC confirmed the agreement through an official announcement, describing the partnership as a mutual defense and trade alliance.

The agreement was also acknowledged by Atlas Forces through its official allies channel, confirming recognition of the partnership by both factions.

Further details regarding the alliance’s specific obligations and any planned joint operations have not been disclosed.
